pages.title: Operator commands
pages.text: /ss (alias /simplyspeakers) offers network listing, info and playback control. Target a network name or a speaker position. Commands require operator access.

pages.title: Control options
pages.text: Commands support play, pause, stop, restart, next, previous, seek, volume, range, shuffle and repeat. Display names identify networks; Speaker IDs link blocks.

pages.title: Java integration
pages.text: SpeakerApi is the server-side control API; call it on the server thread and enforce actor permissions. SpeakerEvents exposes playback changes for integrations.
